im1.description: Index of image file to use as first in time series; default is 1
im1.title: First Image Index

num.description: Number of images to actually use; default is to use all images
num.title: Number of Images

non.description: Turn off default normalization of the output activation image
non.title: Disable Normalization

coef.description: Scaling factor to convert the activation output from floats to short ints
coef.title: Scaling Factor

ort.description: Filename of a time series to which the image data will be orthogonalized before correlations are computed
ort.title: Orthogonalization Time Series

ideal.description: Filename of a time series to which the image data is to be correlated
ideal.title: Ideal Time Series

polref.description: Use polynomials of order 0..# as extra 'orts'; default is 0
polref.title: Polynomial Order

fimfile.description: Filename to save activation magnitudes in
fimfile.title: FIM File

corr.description: Indicates to write correlation output to image file 'fimfile.CORR'
corr.title: Correlation Output Flag

corfile.description: Filename to save correlation image in
corfile.title: Correlation File

cnrfile.description: Filename to save contrast-to-noise image in
cnrfile.title: CNR File

sigfile.description: Filename to save standard deviation image in
sigfile.title: Standard Deviation File

fitfile.description: Image files of the least squares fit coefficients of all the -ort and -polref time series
fitfile.title: Least Squares Fit Coefficients File

subort.description: Filename of the new timeseries of images with the orts and polrefs subtracted out
subort.title: Subtracted Ortho Reference Time Series

clean.description: Output images won't have the +/- 10000 values forced into their corners for scaling purposes
clean.title: Clean Output Flag

clip.description: Set to zero regions of low intensity in output correlations, etc.
clip.title: Clip Low Intensity Output Flag

dfspace.description: Use the 'dfspace' filter to register the images spatially before filtering.
dfspace.title: DF Space Filter Flag

regbase.description: Read image in file 'fname' as the base image for registration
regbase.title: Base Registration Image
